method.comparison: Each stat is normalized against players from the same position in the same competition.
method.normalization: Stats start on a 50-100 scale inside each role/competition. Final ratings blend 70% continuous stat score and 30% rank calibration, then are compressed around 75. 90+ means elite, and 95+ requires a clear gap above the field.
method.missing_stats: Missing stats are ignored and available weights are redistributed.
method.confidence: Competition scores are pulled toward 75 depending on sample size: games / (games + 3).
method.average_influence: Adjusted competition score can only go up: 70% competition score + 30% player average when the player average is higher.
method.placement_bonus: Team placement is added as a weighted score per role: WINNER 100, FINALIST 94, SEMIFINALIST 88, QUARTERFINALIST 82.
method.world_champion_bonus: WINNER rows get +0.5 at 90+, +2 below 90, +4 below 85, +7 below 80, capped at MAX_RATING.
method.finalist_bonus: FINALIST rows get +1.5 below 90, +3 below 85, +5 below 80, capped at MAX_RATING.
method.early_year_reliability: 2013 and 2014 scores are pulled toward EARLY_YEAR_CENTER because those source years have fewer usable stats.
method.minimum_games: Rows with fewer than 3 games are excluded.
